people.text: Jing wants to go somewhere where she can play football outside and where she and her friends can get bikes to ride. She'd like to do some cooking outdoors during the day too.
Carlos hopes to take part in a team sports competition with his friends. He wants the place to have cover available if it rains, and his parents would rather not drive to the location.
Ebba loves animals and wants to learn about different types, and how to make good drawings of them. Her parents want space to arrange a picnic lunch.
Yusuf wants to do something with his friends connected to photography. He'd like to spend the day in an interesting building and to get to solve puzzles.
Sheena doesn't like fast food, but wants a meal during her day. She'd like to do some singing with her friends and would like advice about putting on a really good performance.

items.label: A
items.title: Adventure for All
items.text: This is a fascinating museum with displays on different subjects. It's also the perfect place for special days. Groups will love the "escape room" - answer questions to find hidden keys and escape! There's also a list of the museum's rarest and most unusual objects - make teams and see who can take the best pictures!

items.label: B
items.title: Lomas Centre
items.text: A day out with a difference! For those coming by car, there's parking a kilometre away, then you catch a shuttle bus. Once you're there, you and your group will expect to look after some animals - buy photos of you all feeding penguins!

items.label: C
items.title: Fun Factory!
items.text: There's a huge hall here with plenty to do in bad weather, including volleyball courts with electronic systems to keep score. If you prefer to explore outside spotting wildlife, there are lots of nature tracks for walkers, so no bikes rushing past! The directions to road are clear, or the station's convenient too.

items.label: D
items.title: Bewley Hall
items.text: This place is great for groups of friends, as you'll write the words and music to make your own record! The staff are there to offer tips about creating a professional sound. Being creative is hungry work, and there's a wide range of healthy options on offer at the café.

items.label: E
items.title: Jack's Place
items.text: If a great day means playing sport, this might not be for you. But if you're interested in wildlife, you'll find out about some unusual examples. Then, with just a pencil and paper, you'll create something more interesting than a photo. Head to the hills by the lake if you're bringing refreshments and you want great views.

items.label: F
items.title: Newton Hollow
items.text: There's a mix of forest-based activities to entertain everyone - explore nature, whatever the weather! Those bringing bikes will find various paths, with places to stop and take perfect selfies! There's a café with hot food like pizza, and an amazing range of ice creams for special treats too.

items.label: G
items.title: Action Hub
items.text: The place for creative teens! You'll need to go by car, though the car park's small and busy. There's a daily performance where musicians entertain with songs from shows, making special memories of the day, and a photography exhibition of buildings - try and guess which country they come from!

items.label: H
items.title: Carley's Ground
items.text: The woods have lovely cycle routes - look out for deer! There are bicycles for hire, and you can even borrow a ball and use the pitches there. If you're hungry, choices include barbecuing your burgers in the woods for a picnic or buying snacks from the stall. Remember your outdoors - park suitable clothes in bad weather.

explanations.6: Jing 想在户外踢足球、和朋友骑自行车，白天户外做饭。H 选项 “Carley's Ground” 有自行车出租、足球场，可借球使用场地，还能在树林里烧烤汉堡，符合需求。原文 “bicycles for hire... use the pitches... barbecuing your burgers in the woods” 对应 “play football, ride bikes, cook outdoors”。
explanations.7: Carlos 想和朋友参加团队体育比赛，场地需有雨天遮蔽，父母不愿开车前往。C 选项 “Fun Factory!” 有室内排球场（电子计分），适合雨天，靠近车站交通便利，符合需求。原文 “huge hall... volleyball courts... station's convenient” 对应 “team sports, cover if rain, no driving”。
explanations.8: Ebba 热爱动物，想了解不同类型动物并学好绘画，父母希望有空间野餐。E 选项 “Jack's Place” 专注野生动物，教用铅笔纸创作（比照片更有趣），湖边 hills 适合野餐，符合需求。原文 “interested in wildlife... create something more interesting than a photo... hills by the lake if you're bringing refreshments” 对应 “learn about animals, draw them, picnic space”。
explanations.9: Yusuf 想和朋友做与摄影相关的事，在有趣建筑里解谜。A 选项 “Adventure for All” 有 “逃脱房间”（答题找钥匙），还有博物馆稀有物品拍照比赛，符合需求。原文 “escape room... answer questions to find hidden keys... make teams and see who can take the best pictures” 对应 “photography, solve puzzles, interesting building”。
explanations.10: Bewley Hall 适合朋友团体，可创作自己的唱片，工作人员提供打造专业音效的建议，咖啡馆有健康饮食选择，符合 Sheena“唱歌、表演建议、非快餐” 的需求。原文 “write the words and music to make your own record... staff offer tips about creating a professional sound... café with healthy options” 对应 “singing, performance advice, good meal”。
